query: UPDATE bookings b SET arriving_notified_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE b.status = 'confirmed' AND b.arriving_notified_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM branches fb JOIN organizations fo ON fo.id = fb.org_id WHERE fb.id = b.branch_id AND fo.plan = 'free') AND b.starts_at + interval '30 minutes' > now() AND b.starts_at - make_interval(mins => COALESCE( (SELECT s.hold_minutes FROM branch_booking_settings s WHERE s.branch_id = b.branch_id), 15)) <= now() RETURNING b.id
